code_quality.justification: 8 commits (+867/-31) split across all three members (Alice 2, Bob 3, Charlie 3). Every feature commit is single-purpose and prefixed with its Jira key (e.g. 'AUTH-3: Implement refresh-token rotation and revocation list'), and AUTH-1 reached main through a reviewed PR (#4). Only nit: a .DS_Store file was committed with the AUTH-1 middleware.

executive_summary: In the 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-21 sprint Team_Alpha delivered all 4 tickets (21/21 points) for a JWT auth service: middleware, refresh-token rotation, a unit and integration test suite, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that lints, tests and builds a Docker image on every PR. Commits are descriptive and ticket-keyed, work is evenly shared, and peers rate each other 4.67/5 on average. Gaps are minor: no deploy stage, late untracked documentation and no coverage report.
strengths: Tests and CI built alongside the features
Even workload and specific, high peer ratings
weaknesses: No deployment stage in the pipeline
Documentation delivered late in one untracked commit
key_recommendations: Add a staging deploy job to ci.yml so the pipeline covers CD.
Report test coverage in CI and set a minimum threshold.
Create a documentation ticket and update docs with each feature PR.
Route every feature branch through a reviewed PR, not just AUTH-1.
